7:179.text: And surely, We have created many of the jinn and mankind for Hell. They have hearts wherewith they understand not, and they have eyes wherewith they see not, and they have ears wherewith they hear not
. They are like cattle, nay even more astray; those! They are the heedless ones.

7:180.text: the Most Beautiful Names belong to Allâh
, so call on Him by them, and leave the company of those who belie or deny
His Names. They will be requited for what they used to do.

7:181.text: And of those whom We have created, there is a community who guides
with the truth, and establishes justice therewith.

7:182.text: (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, We shall gradually seize them with punishment in ways they perceive not.

7:183.text: And I respite them; certainly My Plan is strong.

7:184.text: Do they not reflect? There is no madness in their companion
. He is but a plain warner.

7:185.text: Do they not look in the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all things that Allâh has created; and that it may be that the end of their lives is near. In what message after this will they then believe?

7:186.text: Whomsoever Allâh sends astray, none can guide him; and He lets them wander blindly in their transgressions.

7:187.text: They ask you about the Hour
: "When will be its appointed time?" Say: "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord

. None can reveal its time but He. Heavy is its burden through the heavens and the earth. It shall not come upon you except all of a sudden." They ask you as if you have a good knowledge of it. Say: "The knowledge thereof is with Allâh
, but most of mankind know not."
